svg.metadata: {"story":"Jeremiah","act":7,"chapter":"Ch.7 · The Cistern","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The officials cast Jeremiah into the cistern of Malchiah, in the court of the guard, and Ebed-melech the Cushite lifts him out with rags and ropes.
